name: Atene Hagwon ~ Saranggwa Jilliui Byeonjeungbeopjeok Geomjeung ~
original_name: 아테네 학원 ~ 사랑과 진리의 변증법적 검증 ~
source:
The world is in the Great Age of Scholarship. A field that received particular attention during this time was philosophy.
A Philosophical Brain Battle Visual Novel: "Athens Academy"
What on earth will happen at the Athens Academy, a gathering of geniuses...?
translation:
世界正值学问大兴的年代，而在诸多学科之中，哲学尤其受到瞩目。
一部围绕哲学展开智斗的视觉小说——《雅典学园》。
在天才云集的雅典学园里，究竟会上演怎样的故事…？
